content: Kumai he yamoꞋa Kolini veapina hane.

Nago kema falote higeꞋna havuana Yisasi kema nohaviya veaꞋmoꞋya nohaya kefo yana tamakai veapitila nago veaꞋmoꞋya maitama nehae. Nago kanomoꞋa nefa aꞋene kumai heno alitea tamavagea hageꞋna havi-mainoe.
Havuanagi naꞋa higetama tamaugafa alitama nehaiye? NaꞋa higetama tamahauna hutama tamakayea nohigetama tamakaipitila ani kanoa anati noꞋatalae.
Nagaya alule mainoanagi afaꞋa nagu namemoꞋa tamakaiꞋene mainegeꞋna ani kefo yama humainea kanomofena “Kefo ya nehie.” huꞋna Yisasi Kalaisi agile nehue.
AnumayatimoꞋa Yisasi agile alitalu hutama mainageno nagaila nagu namemoꞋene Yisasi Kalaisi tokiyamoꞋene tamakaiꞋena maigahie.

Maigahigi AnumayatimoꞋa kaiyekema hulatesia kanafina ani kanomo agu amena aligatisiafene hutama menia Satani ayapi ateho. SataniꞋa augafaꞋage haesigeno age haꞋyema nehia yamaꞋa haꞋno hisigeno “Kefo ya nehue.” huno aguꞋa aiyahae huno eteno eno.
“Kolini vayaꞋmoꞋya kefo yama hisia kanoa anati-taleho.” huno humaine.

Tamakaya tamaugafama alitama nehaiya yana kanale ohunea kava nehae. Tamakaya ma yafena ohavinao? TaꞋnefaleti kai hame maya talo hageno osi kanoꞋamo halegisia yana maleteno alino havigu hinageno mukiꞋa taꞋnefafi ute ete hinageno haenaga mukiꞋa taꞋnefamoꞋa halenegie. Anima hale negia avamete huno osi kefo ya kanoꞋamoꞋagi mukiꞋa veapinaga ute ete hisigeno ala kefo yana ali falote hugahie.

Hugahigi kaihamema hale negia atafa yana kai hamepitila alitama hagaꞋyu hu neꞋatalaya avamete fatago kavakeꞋya huta maisunafene hutama tamakaipitila kefo yana alitama hagaꞋyu hutaleho. Nayona veaꞋmoꞋya kefo yaꞋamihe haviꞋya sipi sipi hemainaya avamete huno YisasiꞋa tagayama fatago huta maisuna yafe fali-mainegeta kefo yana ohisuna veala maisune.

Ani yafe nayona veaꞋmoꞋya sipi sipia heꞋya muse humainaya avamete huta musena nehuta hale negia yana, vea ali haviya humatesuna kavaꞋene kefo yaꞋene neꞋataleta fatago huta tole lagesa ohavita kelamage kegeꞋya huta maisune.
NagoꞋma kae-malenoa avopina mage huꞋna humainoe “Kumai nehesaya veaꞋnenena tokaetama omaiho.” huꞋna kae-malenoe.

Yisasi kema nohaviya veaꞋmoꞋya kumai nehaya veaꞋnene amakaiꞋamiꞋahekeꞋya amakesa haviꞋya “NagaiꞋniꞋa mukiꞋa yana alisue.” huꞋya nehaya veaꞋnene havige huꞋya musufayama nehaya veaꞋnene ago fali-mainaya veafe “Anumayati mainae.” huꞋya amakisana neꞋvaiya veaꞋnene mukiꞋa mopale mainayafe ani veaꞋnene tokaetama omaiho huꞋna hisugetama hanate haote yatela maisae? Yisasi kema nohaviya veafena mani kea ohunoe.

Ohunogi nagaya Yisasina amakuꞋa amitafa humainaya tamafu-tamakanaꞋya kumai he kavaꞋene agaiꞋahe agesa havino “MukiꞋa yana nagai ya hapaesie.” huno nehisia kavaꞋene ago fali-mainaya veafe “Anumayati mainae.” huꞋya amakisana neꞋvaiya kavaꞋene vayaꞋamihe hu-haviya humate kavaꞋene havili neꞋya aneginagi nehaya kavaꞋene musufayama nehaya kavaꞋenema tamafu-tamakanaꞋyama hisagetama amakaiꞋenena ailokaetama maitama kavela oneho huꞋna hulokiya vaiꞋna avona kae-malenoe.

Anumayamo akave nomalaya veala fako humatesia yana nagai aliꞋyana omalegi Anumaya KotiꞋa agaiꞋa aliꞋyanagino kaiyekea humategahie. TagaiꞋene maineꞋya Yisasina amakuꞋa amitafa humainesaya veala kanaleꞋya hutama fako hutama “Kefo yana ohiho.” hutama amaya hisaya aliꞋyatamia hanegeno Anumaya Koti avopina mage huno kae-maleneane

content.text: “TamakaiꞋene maineno kefo yama nehisia kanomona henati-taleho.” huno kae-maleneane.
